newsitem.title: INDIA: India May nitrogenous fertiliser output 735,000T.
newsitem.headline: India May nitrogenous fertiliser output 735,000T.

text.p: India produced 735,000 tonnes of nitrogenous fertilisers in May against a target of 726,000 tonnes, the Petroleum Ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said in a statement the country produced 235,000 tonnes of phosphatic fertilisers in May against a target of 225,000 tonnes.

The country produced 1.45 million tonnes of nitrogenous fertilisers during April and May against a target of 1.39 million tonnes, and 457,000 tonnes of phosphatic fertilisers against a target of 434,000 tonnes, the ministry said.

It said nitrogenous fertilisers output during April and May was 35.3 percent higher than that of the same period last year, and phosphatic fertilisers output during April and May was 38.9 percent higher when compared with same months last year.
The ministry said 402,000 tonnes of urea were imported in May. Cumulative imports of urea between April 1 and May 31 stood at 649,000 tonnes, compared with 111,000 tonnes in the same period in 1996.
The statement said that 1.67 million tonnes of urea were despatched to the states in May compared with 1.14 million tonnes in May 1996.
